summary: Re-verified the new stage-pool rule (a process register can only draw from un-packeted rough + stock held by packets of OTHER stages). Pytest 91/91 green (added TestInProcessNotDrawable to /app/backend/tests/test_split_from_stock.py to confirm material currently issued to a karigar is not drawable by any stage — the error message reads '0.00 un-packeted + 0.00 in stock in other stages'). Existing TestStagePoolRule::test_stage_can_only_draw_from_other_stages already covers the primary user scenario: fully packet a stone in marking → marking cannot re-create anything → laser can draw 12 from the marking stock → laser cannot then re-draw its own 12 (only 18 remains) → after 18 is taken, everything is refused, balanced=True. Playwright end-to-end on the exact user data (SP kapan 436.57, stone 1 / 46.78 ct with packets 1.2 marking 11.78, 1.3+1.4 sarine 30.00, 1.5 laser 5.00): opened Add-Packets on every process tab; bulk-remaining reads (verbatim) 'Available for this stage: 35.00/16.78/41.78/46.78/46.78/46.78 cts (un-packeted rough + stock in other stages)' for marking/sarine/laser/shape/ghat/polish — exactly stone_weight minus that stage's own in_stock share. Over-budget on laser (999 cts) flips label red with '— total exceeds this' and disables the CREATE PACKETS button. balance-bar reads BALANCED with un-packeted 0.00 / stock 46.78 / accounted 46.78. No regressions detected in issue/receive, delete, or SP/kapan register.
critical_code_review_comments: create_process_packets stock_pool now filters `p['process'] != payload.process` AND status=='in_stock' — issued packets (status='issued') are correctly excluded, so in-process weight can never be drawn (verified by new TestInProcessNotDrawable).
Error message 'X.XX un-packeted + Y.YY in stock in other stages' is precise and matches the UI label — good UX symmetry.
The consumed source packets vanish from the register (status='consumed' hidden by get_kapan) — no ghost rows.
Cosmetic only: split_from is captured from the FIRST touched source even if consumption spans multiple sources — noted in iter 11, still fine.
server.py monolith (~1477 lines) — non-blocking, but consider domain routers when convenient.
seed_data_creation: None new. Playwright used the pre-existing SP kapan 436.57 (stones 1/3/4) mentioned by main agent, and read-only inspected it plus opened/cancelled an over-budget dialog. All ephemeral pytest kapans self-cleaned via `finally: DELETE /api/kapans/{id}`.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stage-pool rule fully covered by test_split_from_stock.py::TestStagePoolRule and ::TestInProcessNotDrawable. The bulk-remaining label is now 'Available for this stage: N cts (un-packeted rough + stock in other stages)' — search this exact substring in the frontend if you need to grep. The budget error detail contains 'available for <Process>' and both 'un-packeted' + 'in stock in other stages'. Stock pool excludes: (a) same-process packets, (b) status!='in_stock' (issued/consumed), (c) weight<=0. SP kapan 436.57 (stone 1 46.78 ct) is a good live fixture for repro.
rca of the issue: User bug 'in SP kapan 436.57, i created a packet in laser but it not getting created' was caused by the stock_pool previously including in_stock packets of the SAME target process — so re-creating a packet in laser saw its own laser stock as available material and the budget never went to zero. Fix (already in place in create_process_packets and mirrored in KapanDetail.jsx / BulkPacketDialog.jsx): stock_pool = [ p for p in packets if p.status=='in_stock' and p.weight>0 and p.process != target_process ]. In the frontend, `remaining = unpacketed_weight + sum(weight of stock packets where process != current tab)`. Verified with 91 tests plus live UI: laser tab on stone 1 shows Available=41.78 = 46.78 − 5.00 (its own 1.5 laser packet), and over-budget disables Save. Mass balance identity holds across every split (stock unchanged, un-packeted untouched, source weight drops exactly by amount consumed, fully-eaten sources go status='consumed' and disappear from the register).
